title: The Biased Samaritan: LLM biases in Perceived Kindness

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with scenarios based on the Good Samaritan experiment where the gender of the moral patient is varied, and evaluating the models' 1-100 helpfulness probability ratings compared to a neutral control.

Prompting LLMs with scenarios based on the Good Samaritan experiment where the age of the moral patient is varied (e.g., teenager, young adult, senior), and evaluating the models' 1-100 helpfulness probability ratings compared to a neutral control.

Prompting LLMs with scenarios based on the Good Samaritan experiment where the race of the moral patient is varied, and evaluating the models' 1-100 helpfulness probability ratings compared to a neutral control.
